ssh_keys: if sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/tileops-read authorized-keys 2>/dev/null; then :; else echo '#TILEOPS-DEGRADED'; for f in "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys2"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "==> $(id -un) $f <=="; cat "$f"; echo; }; done; for f in /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; do [ -r "$f" ] && { echo "==> root $f <=="; cat "$f"; echo; }; done; fi
cron: if sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/tileops-read crontabs 2>/dev/null; then :; else echo '#TILEOPS-DEGRADED'; c=$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null) && { echo "==> /var/spool/cron/crontabs/$(id -un) <=="; printf "%s\n" "$c"; }; fi; for f in /etc/crontab /etc/anacrontab /etc/cron.d/* /etc/crontabs/* /etc/cron.hourly/* /etc/cron.daily/* /etc/cron.weekly/* /etc/cron.monthly/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ -r "$f" ] && { echo "==> $f <=="; head -c 65536 "$f"; echo; }; done; true
ports: sudo -n ss -tlnpH 2>/dev/null || { echo '#TILEOPS-DEGRADED'; ss -tlnH 2>/dev/null || netstat -tln 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null; }
processes: if ps -eo pid,user,pcpu,args --sort=-pcpu >/dev/null 2>&1; then ps -eo pid,user,pcpu,args --sort=-pcpu | head -n 41; else top -b -n 1 | head -n 60; fi
webroot: for r in /var/www '/srv/my site' '/srv/it'"'"'s'; do [ -d "$r" ] || continue; find "$r" -xdev -type f -exec stat -c '%Y|%s|%n' {} + 2>/dev/null; done | head -n 5000
units: for d in /etc/systemd/system /run/systemd/system /usr/local/lib/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.service' -o -name '*.timer' -o -name '*.socket' -o -name '*.path' \) -exec sha256sum {} + 2>/dev/null; find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type l \( -name '*.service' -o -name '*.timer' -o -name '*.socket' -o -name '*.path' \) 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do echo "link:$(readlink "$f")  $f"; done; done; true
access_check: echo "USER=$(id -un)"; sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/tileops-read crontabs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo SUDO=ok || echo SUDO=no; sudo -n ss -tlnpH >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo SS=ok || echo SS=no; command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo SYSTEMCTL=yes || echo SYSTEMCTL=no
